name: Rio de Janeiro
about: Dec–Mar is hot, festive and peak (Carnival usually falls in Feb), Jun–Aug is cooler, drier and much quieter.
overview: Beaches, samba, and two of the world's most famous viewpoints, all within reach of the city's own subway line.
costOverview: A coffee and a quick bite barely cost anything; the cable car and other paid sights are a different price bracket.

specialSeasons.text: Carnival typically falls this month, filling the city with parades, street parties and huge crowds.
